workspace.workflows.page.about: A workflow is a list of steps: fetch pages, search the web, ask the model to summarize, and save the result as a document. Each step can use what earlier steps produced. Only the summarize step calls the model, and it can't use tools, so text from a web page can shape a summary but can't make anything happen. Runs are started by hand for now, and every run records what each step did.
